item.title: AI-Designed Drug Shifts Six Biological-Age Clocks
item.description: A small lung-disease trial links rentosertib to younger proteomic readings, but cannot yet distinguish treatment effects from slower aging.

item.title: HiDream Launches Embodied Model for Robot Robustness
item.description: HiDream’s new world model unifies vision, video, 3D and actions, targeting robots that remain reliable under environmental disruption.

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Evening edition, Sep 7
item.description: · Latent Space launched a tracker comparing which sources frontier answer engines select and how publishers can influence their visibility.（Latent Space） · HashiCorp positioned HCP Terraform as a control plane for infrastructure provisioned and operated by AI agents.（InfoQ 中文） · Ant Group described Loop, an agent team designed to process a continuous stream of production failure cases.（InfoQ 中文） · OpenBMB released MiniCPM5-2B, a 2.52-billion-parameter dense model claiming a 53.9 average across 34 benchmarks for on-device deployment.（MarkTechPost） · Replit opened its first international office in London, establishing a local base for its AI software-development business.（Replit on X） · Krea published a deep dive into its new agents for orchestrating image, video and other creative-production workflows.（Krea on X） · Cloudflare expanded its AI search capabilities to help customer-service representatives and developers query custom organizational data.（InfoQ 中文） · Nvidia’s Sol team open-sourced MiniMax-H3 acceleration that generates video faster than playback and is available through the Reactor API.（MiniMax on X） · ChatGPT’s share of generative-AI web traffic reportedly recovered to 55.5% after Gemini’s earlier gains receded.（The Decoder） · AWS open-sourced Kiro Crew, a framework for running multiple coding agents asynchronously on software-development tasks.（InfoQ 中文） · TiDB detailed an agent architecture pairing a thin execution loop with a substantial database-style control plane.（InfoQ 中文） · Tripo summarized August updates including a new 3D model, rebuilt Gallery, smoother DCC workflows, over 20 viewer formats and faster FBX exports.（Tripo AI on X） · UBS reportedly made demonstrated AI skills a requirement for candidates seeking jobs at the global bank.（The Decoder） · Genspark added Meta’s Muse Spark 1.3 to AI Chat, Code Agent and Claw, claiming fewer tool calls and lower token use.（Genspark on X）

item.title: ⚡ 14 quick hits — Morning edition, Sep 7
item.description: · Lovart published a reusable prompt for vertically splitting photographs into equal original-image and designed-poster halves.（Lovart） · Lovart showcased user-made artwork to position its generative design platform beyond producing conventional marketing assets.（Lovart） · Canva announced that its next AI Vision event will stream from London on September 15.（Canva） · Canva shared a creative-industry talk arguing that AI has made competent execution inexpensive, increasing pressure on creative differentiation.（Canva） · Tencent updated Hy4 Preview to reduce excessive reasoning and over-verification on complex tasks without sacrificing task quality.（Tencent Hunyuan） · Direct-drive robotics company Benmo showcased modular robots that transform within three seconds, with products reportedly sold across 50 countries.（量子位） · GOSIM Shenzhen published its 2026 agenda featuring more than 150 speakers from Nvidia, Microsoft, Hugging Face and other technology organizations.（量子位） · Recraft added a grainy folk-illustration option to its V4 style library, emphasizing bold characters and playful details.（Recraft） · A system combining a 4B Qwen model on phones with cloud-hosted GLM achieved a leading reported result on ARC-AGI 3.（量子位） · Dreamina selected ten weekly community-giveaway winners, each receiving 25,000 credits for its generative creative tools.（Dreamina） · A LobsterAI user report found 12.2% of model calls were unattended, while scheduled tasks averaged 64 calls per instruction.（量子位） · Meshy demonstrated Meshy 7 preserving the alignment of uploaded references while GPT-6 supplied higher-level reasoning.（Meshy） · Zhongke LeibraIn completed a several-hundred-million-yuan Series B+ round led by CRRC Capital for energy-aware AI infrastructure expansion.（量子位） · OpenAI, WAN-IFRA and AIRPPU launched AI training and implementation support for ten independent Ukrainian news organizations.（OpenAI）
